generationRecord.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: JeloCare exact-SKU catalogue packshot
Primary request: Create one premium, clean, complete catalogue packshot of the exact Dove Skin Replenish 2% Niacinamide & BHA Refining Serum Body Wash, 18.5 US fl oz / 547 ml bottle shown in the reference images.
Input images: Image 1 is the high-resolution official Dove identity and material reference; Image 2 is the complete-bottle framing and exact front-label reference.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for later removal; one uniform color with no gradients, texture, horizon, floor plane, shadow, or reflection.
Subject: one complete front-facing white Dove pump bottle. Preserve the exact white pump, warm metallic gold collar, white rounded bottle, gold Dove bird, hot-pink vertical Dove wordmark, SKIN REPLENISH, WITH PINK LILY, 2%, 2% NIACINAMIDE & BHA REFINING SERUM, BODY WASH, and 18.5 FL OZ / 547 mL front-label identity from Image 2. Use Image 1 for crisp bottle materials, typography proportions, and brand colors.
Composition/framing: centered single bottle, fully visible from pump tip to rounded bottle base, generous even padding on every side, square 1:1 canvas.
Lighting/mood: neutral even high-end catalogue lighting; realistic white plastic and metallic collar detail; no cast shadow.
Constraints: preserve the exact real package identity, proportions, pump direction, label placement, wording, spelling, percentages, size, colors, and visible claims from the references. Do not crop any part of the pump or base. No size badge outside the bottle. No extra objects, duplicate bottle, duplicate pump, reflection, props, watermark, or invented claims. Do not use #00ff00 anywhere on the product.
